datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for Belarus
datasets.description: This dataset contains data obtained from the HDX Humanitarian API (HDX HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. The data facilitates automated workflows and visualizations to support humanitarian decision making. For more information, please see the HDX HAPI landing page and documentation .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hdx-hapi-blr]
datasets.details: HDX HAPI is refreshed daily, but the source datasets may have different update schedules. Please refer to the source datasets for each subcategory to verify their specific update frequency.

entity.name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project)

lineage.description: HDX HAPI aggregates standardized humanitarian indicators from multiple authoritative sources (INFORM, ACLED, WFP, UNHCR) through automated data pipelines to provide interoperable risk and impact metrics. The national risk component integrates hazard exposure assessment with vulnerability and coping capacity indices, while food security and displacement data reflect indirect humanitarian impacts. Data is compiled at national and sub-national administrative levels with standardized reference periods for temporal consistency.

sources.name: INFORM
sources.description: Provides standardized risk assessment methodology including hazard exposure, vulnerability, and coping capacity indices used to calculate national risk scores

sources.name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project)
sources.description: Contributes conflict event data including fatalities and event counts as indicators of humanitarian impact

sources.name: WFP - World Food Programme
sources.description: Provides food price and market monitoring data reflecting food security impacts and economic vulnerability

sources.name: UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency
sources.description: Supplies refugee and persons of concern population data indicating displacement and affected populations
